review_text: A *Pour*-fect experience  Just attended this fantastic resin workshop and I'm absolutely *glowing* with excitement! She made sure we were all properly equipped before we started our artistic journey.  Quality Materials - They don't mess around with cheap supplies - only the good stuff! The branded materials used were top-*tier*, ensuring our creations would truly *set* us apart.  Environment - The vibe was incredibly welcoming and open. No pressure, just pure creative *flow*.  The Bottom Line  If you're even *remotely* curious about resin art, this workshop is a no-brainer. review_text: Last week, I attended my very first resin art workshop, and it was truly a wonderful and memorable experience. From the moment I arrived, the atmosphere felt positive and inspiring, setting the perfect tone for a creative session.  Charu was incredibly warm and approachable right from the beginning. She patiently explained each step of the process in a clear and detailed manner, making sure that everyone felt confident and comfortable throughout. Her encouraging words and cheerful presence really helped ease any nervousness I had as a beginner.  What I appreciated most was how hands on the session was we weren’t just watching, but actively creating our own ocean themed resin masterpieces. Charu gave individual attention to each participant, offering tips and suggestions to help us improve our technique.  The materials were well-organized, the space was clean and vibrant, and the overall vibe was both relaxed and creatively energizing.  I walked away not just with a beautiful piece of art, but with a sense of accomplishment and a growing interest in exploring more resin techniques. I’m already looking forward to my next workshop session and can’t wait to learn more!

review_text: This Sunday was truly special—I had the wonderful opportunity to create my very own resin art ocean tray at Mixnosh Café, guided by the incredibly talented Charu ma’am.  The workshop was a perfect blend of creativity and relaxation. Charu ma’am was patient, clear, and so encouraging throughout the entire session. She walked us through each step of working with resin, from mixing and pouring to adding pigments and achieving those beautiful wave effects that make ocean trays so mesmerizing.  Creating the tray felt almost therapeutic. Watching the resin flow and transform into something so serene and beachy was magical. I never thought I could create something so beautiful in just a few hours!  The atmosphere at Mixnosh Café added to the charm—cozy, vibrant, and full of creative energy. It was also a great way to meet like-minded people and share the joy of crafting.  If you’ve ever wanted to try resin art or are just looking for a new hands-on hobby, I highly recommend attending one of Charu ma’am’s workshops. You’ll walk away not just with a beautiful piece of art, but also with a deep sense of accomplishment and joy. 💙

review_text: Mixnosh Cafe in Bangalore is a must-visit for anyone seeking a unique and vibrant experience. This place brilliantly blends healthy, delicious food with creative artistry. From sneaker art to resin masterpieces, it’s a haven for art lovers and food enthusiasts alike.  The café features a talented team of artists and chefs who don’t just serve great food but also showcase stunning works of art. The sneaker art here is one-of-a-kind—you can either customize a pair of sneakers with your dream design or get involved and paint your own, guided by their expert team. Their resin art collection is also impressive, offering everything from bookmarks and coasters to exquisite statement pieces for your home. They regularly host workshops, making it a perfect spot to unleash your creativity.  On the food front, I was thoroughly impressed. I highly recommend the mezze platter, breakfast combo, granola bowls, and the paneer steak—each dish was packed with fresh, vibrant flavors and left me wanting more.  Overall, Mixnosh Cafe offers a fantastic blend of good vibes, great food, and artistic inspiration. Whether you’re looking to enjoy a meal, shop for unique art, or get hands-on with a workshop, this place has something special for everyone.

review_text: MixNosh strikes the perfect balance between a trendy sneaker haven and a cozy dining spot. The decor blends industrial chic with elements of sneaker culture, featuring walls adorned with framed sneakers and shelves displaying limited edition kicks.  The menu at Mixnosh is a delightful fusion of international flavors and local favorites. Standout dishes include their signature Lord of the wings-BBQ, a towering masterpiece with juicy chicken/lamb patties or veg options, sandwiched between artisanal buns. Our favourites were the Lamb Burger, Chicken wings, Onion rings, Hummus &Pita, Loaded Nachos, London Fish and Chips and the Snickoto shake  The service at Mixnosh is exemplary. The staff is knowledgeable about both sneakers and the menu, offering recommendations with genuine enthusiasm. They are attentive to detail, ensuring a seamless dining and shopping experience for every guest.  Mixnosh is more than just a cafe; it's a destination for sneaker aficionados and food lovers alike. With its impressive sneaker collection, delectable menu offerings, attentive service, and vibrant ambiance. MixNosh sets the bar high for sneaker/food cafes in Bangalore.  Highly recommended for anyone seeking a unique dining experience with a twist of sneaker culture.
